archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp2317.0: The courier would not say where the door came from. Only that it should stay shut.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp2317_door.1: SCP-2317: an ornate double door of dark wood set in a carved stone frame. Keter-class.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp2317_door.2: It will not open until a certain file has been read. It cannot be removed while anyone is on the other side.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp2317_door.3: It never spawns naturally. Its file comes from the Archive.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.title: A Door to Another World
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.caption: SCP-2317 in its holding chamber. The doors are not to be opened without authorisation from the O5 Council.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.0.text.0: SCP-2317 is to remain closed. It has never opened for anyone before the file designated SCP-001 "The Scarlet King" was read. Since then it opens for anyone, and always onto the same place.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.0.text.1: While anyone is on the far side, SCP-2317 cannot be damaged by any means tested. With nobody beyond it, it may be removed with ordinary tools.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.0.text.2: **Personnel who pass through are to return through the second doorway that stands in the sand on the far side.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.1.text.0: SCP-2317 is an ornate double door of dark wood, iron-bound, set in a carved stone frame. Faint red glyphs in an unknown script run along its lintel and leaves. They are carved, not painted.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.1.text.1: Beyond the doors lies SCP-2317-1: a pale desert under a hazy red-gold sky in which the sun never sets. No life has been found there. Seven weathered stone pillars stand in a ring at its centre, and between them an ancient clay vase rests on a low dais.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.2.title: Addendum 2317-A: Beneath the Sand
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.2.text.0: Excavation beneath the ring revealed a cavern. At its centre a vast figure of stone kneels in the dark, bound by seven chains to seven pillars.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.2.text.1: The figure resembles the entity described in the SCP-001 file. Every chain that has failed has failed without any visible cause. %rNone has ever been repaired.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.3.title: Addendum 2317-B: Recovered Fragment
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.3.text.0: "The old rites asked for a living offering at the vessel, and a walk around the circle: sunwise, then widdershins. The sleeper would breathe out, and the world would be quieter for a time."
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.3.text.1: Researchers note that the fragment predates every known record of the site.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.4.title: Addendum 2317-C: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.2317.page.4.text: SCP-2317 was handed to a reader of this file by a Foundation courier. See field notes.
